mechanism: Trained code retriever and reranker over the repository with an agentic search loop that keeps a memory buffer of candidates
evidence_scope: SWERANKAGENT adopts an agentic search loop that moves be- yond single-shot localization with a memory buffer to reason and accumulate relevant lo- calization candidates over multiple turns.
evidence_role: This work introduces SWERANK+ 1, a framework that couples SWERANKMULTI, a cross-lingual code ranking tool, with SWERANKAGENT, an agentic search setup, for iterative, multi-turn reasoning over the code repository.
